terms.DELETED: Applied to a record: the row is removed from the primary database by a governed, audited executor in a committed transaction, every dependent copy listed in this matrix has its stated expiry action, and the deletion is entered in the deletion ledger. Applied to an Identity: the Identity row becomes the DELETED tombstone (id, status, created_at only) and every personal-data record of the subject is hard-deleted or expired per §4. DELETED is terminal.
terms.ANONYMIZED: Applies only to aggregate outputs from which no individual record can be recovered, with a minimum cell size of 5 identities per reported group (proposed engineering value). An individual-level record is never called anonymized, regardless of hashing.
terms.PSEUDONYMIZED (technical term, not one o: Direct identifiers replaced by a value that still allows linkage — opaque IDs while a mapping exists, keyed or unkeyed hashes, payload hashes. Pseudonymized data is personal data. Code and documents MUST NOT call it anonymized.
terms.RETAINED: The record is kept unchanged, readable only through C14-authorized operations, until its retention clock plus duration elapses; then its expiry action runs. Retention never extends authentication validity.
terms.OFFBOARDED: Exactly the IDN-18 effects in one transaction: IdentityStatus INACTIVE, IdentityOffboarded emitted, all sessions revoked, frontline credentials and pending single-use tokens revoked, effective Membership and grants removed through the Organization boundary. Offboarding deletes nothing and starts retention clocks.

record_classes.retention_clock_start: offboarded_at; for non-offboard deactivation: UNDEFINED (no deactivated_at column)
record_classes.expiry_action: Transition to DELETED tombstone: row kept with id/status/created_at only so immutable audit and lifecycle references stay valid. Requires C11 revision authorizing DELETED ingress solely from the retention/deletion executor (DB trigger currently blocks it).
record_classes.offboarding_effect: status INACTIVE, offboarded_at set once, IdentityOffboarded emitted (IDN-18). No data removed.
record_classes.subject_deletion_action: Same as expiry action, executed on request after verification (PRIV-11), subject to holds.
record_classes.legal_hold_effect: Suspends expiry action and subject deletion for matching rows; does not suspend offboarding, revocation or authentication denial.
gaps: No deactivated_at timestamp: retention clock for DeactivateIdentity (non-offboard) cannot start.
DELETED ingress blocked by identity_guard_identity_update trigger; any deletion implementation is BLOCKED until C11 changes.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.note: Argon2id PHC string after OQ-IDN-1; authentication verifier, never an anonymization device

record_classes.expiry_action: Hard DELETE of the row.
record_classes.offboarding_effect: Credential revoked (revoked_at set) in the offboarding transaction (IDN-18).
record_classes.subject_deletion_action: Hard DELETE of every credential row of the identity in the deletion transaction (no hold exemption needed: a hash has no evidentiary value).
record_classes.legal_hold_effect: Suspends expiry action and subject deletion for matching rows; does not suspend offboarding, revocation or authentication denial.
gaps: RECOMMENDATION R-1: retaining a revoked password hash for one year keeps an offline-crackable secret with no evidentiary use. Recommended correction: null password_hash at revocation and keep the row (type, revoked_at) for the 1-year history. Requires C11/P04 domain change (PASSWORD rows currently require a hash).

record_classes.expiry_action: Hard DELETE of the row.
record_classes.offboarding_effect: All ACTIVE sessions REVOKED in the offboarding transaction (IDN-18, SES-14).
record_classes.subject_deletion_action: Hard DELETE of all session rows of the identity.
record_classes.legal_hold_effect: Suspends expiry action and subject deletion for matching rows; does not suspend offboarding, revocation or authentication denial.
gaps: Record retention is not validity: SES-11 (12h absolute / 30m idle) still governs authentication.

record_classes.expiry_action: Sink deletes at 90 days. UNKNOWN: no sink meets 90 days by default (Vercel ≤30d by plan; Sentry 30d lookback).
record_classes.subject_deletion_action: Not individually deleted; ages out at 90 days. Logs must not contain direct identifiers (OBS-2), which makes per-subject deletion unnecessary.
record_classes.legal_hold_effect: Not applicable (no per-subject content).

record_classes.retention_duration: UNKNOWN (provider retention configuration; MIG-9 requires ≥ daily backups)
record_classes.expiry_action: Provider ages backups out. Deleted subjects persist in backups until then.
record_classes.subject_deletion_action: Not edited. Subject data in backups expires with the backup. Any restore MUST replay the deletion ledger before the restored database serves traffic.
record_classes.legal_hold_effect: Holds do not extend backups; a hold that needs data beyond backup age requires an explicit export to a held archive.
gaps: Backup retention window W is UNKNOWN; the privacy statement may promise only "deleted from backups within W days" once W is evidenced (PRIV-14, PRIV-17).
